identity.title: [v0.92][Observatory] Deploy public exposure with Route53 and ACM

values.summary: Implemented and validated the CSM public edge Terraform stack, disposable Spot EC2 origin stack, and disposable ALB origin stack. Review remediation now rejects path-bearing wss_origin_https_url values unless future work adds explicit CloudFront origin_path support, documents the host-only WSS origin contract, and stops claiming that the bundled live validator proves a WebSocket handshake. Historical operator-authorized AWS apply/origin smoke/teardown evidence remains retained; current post-fix proof is local, non-live, and publication WSS handshake proof remains an explicit residual gate for an approved Runtime WebSocket probe.
actual_changes: Changed the WSS origin guard so wss_origin_https_url must exactly equal https://wss_origin_hostname with no path.
Updated WSS origin variable/docs/runbook wording to describe host-only HTTPS origins and future origin_path requirements.
Added static-validator assertions that reject path-bearing WSS origin acceptance without CloudFront origin_path support.
Updated VPP live-lane truth so the bundled live validator proves HTTPS/CORS/API reachability only and does not claim a successful WebSocket handshake.
